description: This file contains the definition of the TaxClass model class within the Opencart Admin's localisation namespace. It includes methods for managing tax classes such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax class data, as well as managing associated tax rules and statistics.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing tax classes and their associated rules within the Opencart localization module.

methods.name: addTaxClass
methods.description: Creates a new tax class record in the database and adds associated tax rules if provided.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Updates an existing tax class record and its associated rules.

methods.name: deleteTaxClass
methods.description: Removes a tax class and its related rules from the database.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific tax class by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxClasses
methods.description: Fetches a list of all tax classes with optional ordering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTaxClasses
methods.description: Returns the total number of tax classes in the database.

methods.name: addTaxRule
methods.description: Adds a tax rule associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: deleteTaxRules
methods.description: Deletes all tax rules associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRules
methods.description: Retrieves all tax rules associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRulesByTaxRateId
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct tax classes linked to a specific tax rate.
